changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table org_unit ( id uuid not null, name varchar(255) not null, kind varchar(30) not null, parent_id uuid, manager_id uuid, path varchar(1000) not null, depth integer not null, active boolean not null, primary key (id) );
alter table org_unit add constraint fk_org_unit_parent foreign key (parent_id) references org_unit (id);
alter table org_unit add constraint fk_org_unit_manager foreign key (manager_id) references users (id);
create index idx_org_unit_path on org_unit (path varchar_pattern_ops);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists org_unit cascade;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table org_unit_audit ( id uuid not null, rev integer not null, revtype smallint, name varchar(255), kind varchar(30), parent_id uuid, manager_id uuid, active boolean, primary key (rev, id) );
alter table org_unit_audit add constraint fk_org_unit_audit_revinfo foreign key (rev) references revinfo (id);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists org_unit_audit cascade;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: alter table users add column org_unit_id uuid;
alter table users add constraint fk_users_org_unit foreign key (org_unit_id) references org_unit (id);
alter table users_audit add column org_unit_id uuid;

rollback.sql: alter table users_audit drop column if exists org_unit_id;
alter table users drop column if exists org_unit_id;
